abilities.description: You now command your capital-class ship, and may go where you want. Start a progress track, difficulty formidable, and call it “Command the Fleet.” When it is full, you command an entire Rebel fleet and give it a name. When that happens, envision three other capital-class ships to follow you, their commanders, and take +2 on all @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.9f538fabf8998c5b]{Compel} moves to direct them. Until then, as Commander of your single ship, when you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.a903d120af3b1475]{Battle}, you may re-roll any challenge dice.

When you roll for @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.3ff03b51f620ab26]{Undertake an Expedition}, you cannot get less than a weak hit, and when you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.9f538fabf8998c5b]{Compel} using the threat of your capital ship, add +1.
If assisted by your crew in anything, take +2.
